children: XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera may benefit from merger-cost normalization, UOB Kay Hian analysts say in a research report. With an accelerated depreciation now completed and integration costs nearing an end, the quality of the telecommunications services provider's earnings should improve from 4Q, the analysts say. This, together with continued average-revenue-per-user recovery and merger synergies, could support a similar rerating trajectory to peer Indosat. The brokerage maintains the stock's buy rating, but lowers the target price to 3,000.00 rupiah from IDR3,600.00 to reflect concerns that elevated 5G capital expenditure could strain the Indonesian company's balance sheet amid high rates. Shares are 2.6% lower at IDR1,680.00. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
